changeSet.author: wasnertobias
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_workflows ADD COLUMN status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'deprecated', 'ignored')), ADD COLUMN deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ, ADD COLUMN tag TEXT; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_workflows_tag ON ai_workflows(tag) WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL;

changeSet.author: wasnertobias
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE ai_workflow_steps ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, workflow_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ai_workflows(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT NOT NULL, sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tag TEXT, recommended_sla TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (recommended_sla IN ('ux-critical', 'ux-high-prio', 'ux-background')), confirmed_sla TEXT CHECK (confirmed_sla IS NULL OR confirmed_sla IN ('ux-critical', 'ux-high-prio', 'ux-background')), objective_priority JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '["latency","quality","price"]'::jsonb, confirmed_objective_priority JSONB ); CREATE INDEX idx_ai_workflow_steps_workflow ON ai_workflow_steps(workflow_id, sort_order); CREATE INDEX idx_ai_workflow_steps_tag ON ai_workflow_steps(tag) WHERE tag IS NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE ai_llm_call_recommendations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS step_id INTEGER REFERENCES ai_workflow_steps(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_llm_call_recommendations DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS step_id; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ai_workflow_steps;

changeSet.author: wasnertobias
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE log_entry ADD COLUMN workflow_tag TEXT, ADD COLUMN workflow_id INTEGER, ADD COLUMN workflow_step_id INTEGER, ADD COLUMN request_sla TEXT CHECK (request_sla IS NULL OR request_sla IN ('ux-critical', 'ux-high-prio', 'ux-background')); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_log_entry_workflow_tag ON log_entry(workflow_tag, timestamp_request DESC) WHERE workflow_tag IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_log_entry_workflow_id ON log_entry(workflow_id, timestamp_request DESC) WHERE workflow_id IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: wasnertobias
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ai_workflow_benchmarks ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, workflow_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ai_workflows(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, candidate_model TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'succeeded' CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed')), sample_size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, historic_metrics JSONB, candidate_metrics JSONB, error TEXT, created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ ); CREATE INDEX idx_ai_workflow_benchmarks_workflow ON ai_workflow_benchmarks(workflow_id, created_at DESC);

changeSet.author: wasnertobias
changeSet.sql: -- The workflow of the previous analysis this one continues, so -- history (request attribution, benchmarks) follows the logical -- workflow across re-analyses instead of its current tags. ALTER TABLE ai_workflows ADD COLUMN previous_workflow_id INTEGER REFERENCES ai_workflows(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_workflows DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS previous_workflow_id;

changeSet.author: wasnertobias
changeSet.sql: -- Logos-admin ordered ranking of application keys across teams. -- Lower rank number = higher dequeue priority within the same SLA -- bucket (raw_priority). Unranked keys keep the historical -- role_rank tiebreak only. CREATE TABLE application_key_queue_ranks ( api_key_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES api_keys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, rank INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rank >= 1), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_application_key_queue_ranks_rank ON application_key_queue_ranks(rank);
